title: Sound Muter
description: Adjust or mute any sound in Minecraft, from vamilla effects to modded audio. This tool gives you individual control over every audio source.
body:
# Sound Muter
Click the note button on the ESC menu to open the mod's interface.
From there, you can mute or change the volume of any sound in the game.



# Volume Control
You can add sounds to the main screen and configure each one individually.
- 0% to 200% volume by default
- If 200% is not enough, type any number into the text field on the right (e.g., 300) and the slider expands its range to 300%


# Buttons
- **Add sound**: opens a list of every sound available in the game
- **Recent sounds**: opens a list of sounds that just played. If you hear something annoying, find it in the recent list and send it to the main screen to tweak it
- **Settings**: opens interface options. Here, you can drag the note button to any position on the ESC screen or reset it to default.
- **Back**: closes the Sound Muter menu. (WOW O-O)
